summary: You have solid leadership experience and basic computer skills, which are great assets as you complete your high school journey. Since you need free options, study from a smartphone with limited data, and cannot relocate from KwaZulu-Natal, there are flexible, remote pathways to explore. These steps will let you test digital career fields at no cost before making your next big decision.

direction.title: Digital Skills and Tech Support Exploration
direction.why: Because you are not sure what direction to take yet, learning digital fundamentals allows you to explore various career paths without needing Pure Maths. It lets you build confidence using the smartphone you already have while figuring out what you enjoy most.

skills_you_have.note: You already have proven experience taking responsibility and guiding others through your school, church, or community activities.
You have a starting foundation in using digital tools, which is essential for any modern workplace.

skills_to_build.why: It is the third-fastest-growing skill globally, with 51% of employers considering it a core skill today.
skills_to_build.how: Complete introductory digital and career modules through accessible smartphone platforms.

skills_to_build.why: Employers are rapidly seeking these skills; ICT Security Specialist and Computer Network and Systems Engineer are on South Africa's national list of occupations in high demand.
skills_to_build.how: Start with self-paced beginner online courses that explain how networks and digital protection work.

soft_skills.advice: Keep records of your community, club, or church responsibilities on your CV to demonstrate your teamwork and initiative.
Use team-based projects or volunteer mentoring roles to show employers how you listen to others and help solve group problems.
Earning self-paced digital badges through free programmes like MTN Skills Academy or Cisco Skills for All will show employers you take initiative to learn.

programmes.why_it_fits: It is completely free, runs online, and starts with a career guidance questionnaire that helps you figure out your interests directly from your phone.
programmes.what_you_meet: You meet the open audience requirement; anyone can sign up for free without pre-requisites.
programmes.what_to_check: Check their official website to register and confirm how well the portal runs on mobile data.

programmes.why_it_fits: This offers free, self-paced learning in cybersecurity and networking that you can study from home in KwaZulu-Natal without travel costs.
programmes.what_you_meet: There are no formal matric or math requirements stated, making it accessible while you finish school.
programmes.what_to_check: Check the official Cisco Skills for All website to see data consumption and smartphone browser compatibility.

programmes.why_it_fits: It is fully remote and provides an alternative to traditional university by training you for tech roles without requiring you to move.
programmes.what_you_meet: You are in the 18-24 age group and can apply once you complete Grade 12.
programmes.what_to_check: You need a Grade 12 certificate (NQF 4) to qualify, so you must pass matric first. Check umuzi.org for aptitude test details, computer equipment support, and data provisions, as costs are not stated.

programmes.why_it_fits: If you decide to study full-time at a public TVET college or university after matric, NSFAS provides free bursary and loan funding for qualifying students.
programmes.what_you_meet: As a Grade 11/12 learner planning ahead, you can prepare your documentation early.
programmes.what_to_check: Applying to an institution and applying for NSFAS are separate steps. Check nsfas.org.za for exact eligibility criteria, and note that the 2027 cycle dates closed on 31 October 2026, so you must check for the next open application window.

next_steps: Sign up on the MTN Skills Academy platform using your smartphone to take their free career guidance assessment.
Focus on passing your Grade 12 certificate, as it unlocks funded pathways like Umuzi and NSFAS-backed college programmes.
Explore a free beginner cybersecurity topic on Cisco Skills for All to see if digital and tech support work excites you.
